country_profile.notes_unique: World's fourth-largest island; over 90% of its wildlife is found nowhere else on Earth; Austronesian origins link its language and culture to Southeast Asia.

natural_resources.notes: World's largest vanilla producer (~80% of global supply); Ambatovy nickel/cobalt mine (one of largest in world); ilmenite mining at Fort Dauphin; massive sapphire deposits; unique biodiversity (90% endemic species) is itself a resource via ecotourism.

military.notes: People's Armed Forces; historically involved in politics (2009 coup); gendarmerie handles most rural security; limited naval capacity despite enormous maritime zone.

infrastructure.notes: Telma, Orange, Airtel; poor rural infrastructure; canal des pangalanes.

debt_aid.notes: HIPC debt relief; heavily aid-dependent; France, World Bank, AfDB major donors; political instability deters investment; vanilla price volatility affects economy.

education.notes: Education quality declining; many children drop out by secondary level; language of instruction debates (Malagasy vs French); teacher absenteeism; private schooling growing in cities.

diaspora_migration.notes: French diaspora largest community; relatively low outmigration given population size; internal rural-urban migration significant.

digital_economy.notes: METISS submarine cable improved connectivity; mobile money expanding rapidly; BPO/call centre industry serving French market; Telma, Orange, Airtel operators.

country_profile.national_anthem: Ry Tanindrazanay malala ô! (Oh, Our Beloved Fatherland!)

geography.terrain: Central highland plateau; eastern rainforest escarpment; western dry deciduous forest; southern spiny desert; Mozambique Channel separates from mainland
geography.notes: 4th largest island globally; separated from Africa ~88 million years ago; 90%+ species endemic; biodiversity hotspot; unique lemur habitat.

economy_extended.notes: Vanilla (#1 global, 80% world supply); mining (nickel, ilmenite, cobalt—Ambatovy mine); textile exports; chronic political instability stunting growth; 75% poverty rate.

health.notes: Plague outbreaks (bubonic and pneumonic, 2017); Kere famine in south (2021); community health workers; traditional medicine widespread; COVID-19 'remedy' controversy.

food_agriculture.notes: #1 vanilla producer globally (80%); cloves, cacao, coffee, lychee exports; rice main staple (deficit); south drought/Kere famine-prone.

energy.notes: JIRAMA state utility; frequent power outages; huge untapped hydro, solar, wind potential; rural access extremely low.

transport.notes: Poor road infrastructure; Route Nationale 7 most famous; canal des pangalanes; limited rail.

tourism.notes: Unique biodiversity (90%+ endemic); lemurs iconic; baobabs; eco-tourism; beach tourism (Nosy Be); political instability deters visitors.

human_rights_gender.notes: Child labor extremely high (mica mining); political crises (2009 coup); child marriage widespread; women's labor participation high but informal.

border_disputes: Scattered Islands (France: Glorieuses, Juan de Nova, Bassas da India, Europa)
security_stability.notes: Dahalo banditry in rural south; political instability cyclical; 2023 election controversial; periodic cyclone disasters.

cultural_heritage.media_landscape: TVM state; multiple private FM; MBS, RTA; relatively diverse media
cultural_heritage.notes: Austronesian+African origins (unique in Africa); 18 ethnic groups; fady (taboos); ancestor veneration; valiha national instrument.

legal_system.legal_tradition: Civil law (French system) with Malagasy customary law elements
legal_system.notes: 4th Republic; High Constitutional Court; frequent constitutional crises; Fokonolona community governance.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.
